opening.argument: The presentation lays out a GTIFY Protocol and Web3 business plan through slides that describe how its packages and bonuses are structured. The speaker introduces “two packages,” characterizes the plan as “the game of networking,” and discusses returns and rewards alongside referral and network requirements. Those figures are presented as components of the plan, not as verified results. The slides likewise list income categories and depict conditions for direct bonuses and group-matching rewards. The observable record supports describing what the plan proposes; it does not establish that a payment was made, a reward was received, a withdrawal occurred, or an external service performed as presented.
